sections.heading: Terrain Toolsoperator
sections.content:
The Terrain Tools operator contains tools for accessing terrain data.

Print grid height info: will print terrain grid height information (min/max/range/Unreal Engine z-scale) to the MAXScript Listener, for all terrain grids in the event.Snap selected objects to terrain: will move selected objects to the nearest point (along the Z-axis) on the nearest terrain grid in the event.
